0022600174.text: The Wizards, 4-3 and first in the Southeast, are hosting the Hawks in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, riding a two-game winning streak and holding a 2-1 home record. Atlanta arrives at 4-4, second in the Southeast half a game back and sixth in the East, with a one-game winning streak. Washington is without Alex Sarr, Anthony Gill, Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar, Jalen Johnson, Jock Landale, Mouhamed Gueye and Kingston Flemings, who is serving a suspension, and the teams have not met yet this season.
